Theorem
[Strict volume decrease under cusp filling] \group relative-invariant ↗ thurston-ch06-strict-gromov-rigidity ↗ thurston-ch06-relative-gromov-proportionality Source: thurston:page-0151

If $M_1$ is complete finite-volume hyperbolic and $M_2\neq M_1$ is obtained by replacing some cusps of $M_1$ by solid tori and is hyperbolic, then \[ v(M_1)>v(M_2). \]
